Hard call: C coded via successor MMMU-Pro (6a: same creators + explicitly names flaws of predecessor - text-only answerable questions, option shortcuts); if C-via-successor were rejected the unit would be alive (no AB). Labs migrated to MMMU-Pro (OpenAI reports only MMMU Pro from GPT-5.2, 2025-12). Not checked: arXiv full-text search (API robots-blocked).
